text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The annual Summer Training Camp is about 
to begin once again. Hishi Amazon 
reminisces about the previous year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A lot happened, but it's all good memories 
now. With a powerful smile, she headed 
into the training camp!
